summary: Iteration 116 backend + web frontend testing for TeamNest.ai super-admin + workspace + help features. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass (super-admin user detail/edit/reset-password/reset-link, create-workspace free vs paid, rename gating owner vs non-owner). Web frontend: All acceptance-criteria testIDs and flows verified EXCEPT one CRITICAL runtime bug on /reset-password — page crashes with `ReferenceError: PasswordInput is not defined` (missing import in /app/frontend/src/pages/web/ResetPassword.jsx), so users clicking the emailed reset link see a red-screen and cannot set a new password. Every other flow works: password show/hide toggle on /login, chat workspace selector positioned between search and filter chips with 'New workspace' entry, Create-workspace dialog with Free/Student/Pro/Team plans (Free instantly creates + navigates back to /chats), Super Admin user row click opens sa-user-detail modal with all edit fields + Reset & email password (shows new password + copy + email_sent) + Reset link (shows sa-reset-link-result single-use URL), Help Center at /help with search filtering ('credit limits' → 3 articles, 'student' → 4 articles, nonsense → help-empty) + category chips + article expand + nav-help sidebar link, Team page workspace-name input disabled + Save button hidden for non-owner raj (403 gate) and editable + Save present for owner mate1.

ui_bugs.issue: Red-screen runtime error: 'ReferenceError: PasswordInput is not defined'. PasswordInput is used at lines 89 and 105 of /app/frontend/src/pages/web/ResetPassword.jsx but never imported. The whole reset-password flow (from Super Admin reset-link OR forgot-password email link) is broken end-to-end — users can't submit a new password.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration116_superadmin_workspace_help.py (9 tests, all green). Web UI critical bug: /reset-password page throws `PasswordInput is not defined` — verify main agent adds the missing import from '@/components/ui-v2/PasswordInput'. After the fix, navigate to /reset-password?token=<real-token-from-POST /api/superadmin/users/reset-link> and confirm reset-password-input + reset-password-input-toggle + reset-confirm-input + reset-confirm-input-toggle render and toggle mask correctly. All other acceptance flows already verified — no need to re-test unless code changes touched those areas.
rca of the issue: ResetPassword.jsx was refactored to use the shared PasswordInput atom (introducing testId props reset-password-input / reset-confirm-input) but the corresponding `import { PasswordInput } from '@/components/ui-v2/PasswordInput'` line was never added at the top of the file. The imports block (lines 1-8) covers only Link, toast, lucide icons, api, WebThemeProvider, SeoHelmet and LogoMark/Wordmark/PrimaryButton. React therefore throws a ReferenceError as soon as the render tree tries to instantiate <PasswordInput/>, causing the whole page to red-screen. Reproduction: visit /reset-password?token=<any-valid-or-invalid-token> → runtime error overlay. Fix: add `import { PasswordInput } from '@/components/ui-v2/PasswordInput';` (or the correct alias — matches Auth.jsx which imports it successfully).
